title: ASC 740 Income Tax Provision - DemoCo FY2026
conclusionSummary: At a 25% statutory rate on 1,000,000 USD of pretax income, DemoCo's FY2026 provision is 247,500 USD: current tax 235,000 on taxable income of 940,000 after permanent and temporary differences, a 10,000 increase in unrecognized tax benefits, and deferred tax expense of 2,500 as the net deferred position moves from a 25,000 liability to a 27,500 liability (the 20,000 valuation allowance released as the loss carryforward is used). Effective rate 24.75%.
